decisions.reason: Given the firm's sunk investment and public commitment to this waterproof lined safety shoe range, temporary pandemic-related market conditions likely explain weak online visibility, so management escalates commitment and keeps it.

Because the firm has invested in this electrostatic-dissipative shoe and committed to it publicly, the disappointing archived presence is attributed to temporary causes, leading management to persist.
As a multi-model safety shoe series close to the firm's established offer, substantial investments and public commitment make management reluctant to drop it despite weak results.
